mapper.select: /* User04Mapper.selectUserRankSortIdx */ SELECT D.SORT_IDX FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D D ON D.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND D.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM007' AND D.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = U.RANK_CD AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} LIMIT 1

/* User04Mapper.selectPresetStepsByUser */ SELECT D.PRESET_ID AS presetId , D.STEP_NO AS stepNo , D.APPROVER_USER_CD AS approverUserCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , U.USER_ID AS userId FROM TB_APRV_LINE_PRESET P INNER JOIN TB_APRV_LINE_PRESET_D D ON D.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND D.PRESET_ID = P.PRESET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = D.APPROVER_USER_CD WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.PRESET_ID ASC, D.STEP_NO ASC
